offerings.name: Search (/search)
offerings.pricing: $7 / 1k requests (up to 10 results); 每超出10条结果 $1 / 1k results
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 基础档（含前10条结果）
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（URLs and page contents；可选 AI summary / highlights / structured outputs）
offerings.note: 实时搜索含 token-efficient page contents；另有 Instant/Fast/Auto/Deep 等模式。

offerings.name: Deep Search
offerings.pricing: deep-lite $12 / 1k requests; deep $12 / 1k requests; deep-reasoning $15 / 1k requests
offerings.output_type: 带引用的结构化多步研究结果 (structured outputs and citations)
offerings.note: Latency: deep-lite ~4s, deep 4–15s, deep-reasoning 12–40s；额外结果与 AI 摘要按标准搜索计费。

offerings.name: Answer (/answer)
offerings.output_type: 带引用的 LLM 答案 (An LLM answer to a question, with citations)

offerings.name: Monitors (/monitors)
offerings.pricing: $15 / 1k requests; 每超出10条结果 $1 / 1k results；AI 页面摘要 $1 / 1k pages
offerings.price_basis: PAYG 基础档（含前10条结果）
offerings.output_type: Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web

offerings.name: Contents (/contents)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG per content type（text/highlights/summary 各计一次）
offerings.output_type: 已知名 URL 的全文、highlights 和摘要

offerings.name: Agent API
offerings.pricing: 固定档: minimal $0.012, low $0.025, medium $0.10, high $0.50, xhigh $1.00 / request；或计量计费 ACU $0.10/ACU, search tool call $0.005/次
offerings.price_basis: 固定 effort 按请求计价；auto 默认计量（$5 cap），beta max 计量（$20 cap）
offerings.output_type: Async deep research, list building, and enrichment
offerings.note: Connect 数据源调用额外计费。
